claim_boundary: Development and frozen-audit planning only; not benchmark-comparable.

hypotheses.name: hidden_family_mix
hypotheses.hypothesis: Hidden-family mix explains the aggregate validation-test gap.
hypotheses.primary_signal: Validation and test predeclared-slice aggregates show the gap concentrated in a small set of hidden families.
hypotheses.revise_if: The gap persists within most matched hidden families.

hypotheses.name: component_ownership
hypotheses.primary_signal: LLM-owned, deterministic-owned, projection-owned, and safety-floor-owned rows have different validation-test gaps after family stratification.
hypotheses.revise_if: Ownership strata have similar gaps once hidden family is controlled.

hypotheses.name: candidate_generation_transfer
hypotheses.primary_signal: Gold-relevant candidate exposure is high on validation hard slices but lower on predeclared test slice aggregates or synthetic paraphrases.
hypotheses.revise_if: Candidate recall is stable while later components fail.

hypotheses.name: evidence_transfers_projection_does_not
hypotheses.hypothesis: Evidence selection transfers, but projection or rendering does not.
hypotheses.primary_signal: Exact evidence and source-id rates are stable while projection or adapter layers create validation-test divergence.
hypotheses.revise_if: Evidence validity falls alongside final accuracy.

hypotheses.name: deterministic_repair_masks_llm_weakness
hypotheses.hypothesis: Deterministic semantic repair masks LLM weakness on validation.
hypotheses.primary_signal: Raw LLM or format-only layers have a larger gap than full repair, and full repair owns prediction-bearing changes.
hypotheses.revise_if: Same-raw-output ladder attributes gains to LLM-owned selected facts.

hypotheses.name: selective_action_transfers
hypotheses.hypothesis: Safety-floor and selective-action policies transfer better than broad replacement.
hypotheses.primary_signal: Change-only rows show high changed-label precision and low correct-to-wrong rate on validation and frozen aggregate test summaries.
hypotheses.revise_if: Safety floor suppresses useful test changes or selective-action gains vanish.

hypotheses.name: template_brittleness
hypotheses.hypothesis: Template brittleness, not clinical complexity, causes the gap.
hypotheses.primary_signal: Paraphrase or minimal-pair panels preserve gold facts but flip component behavior by wording, order, section placement, or distractor changes.

hypotheses.name: benchmark_format_conventions
hypotheses.hypothesis: Benchmark-format conventions dominate a subset of the gap.
hypotheses.primary_signal: Convention-tagged rows have poor transfer and strong disagreement between clinical-state correctness and Gan label exactness.
hypotheses.revise_if: The gap remains after excluding convention-dominated slices.

hypotheses.name: action_policy_shift
hypotheses.hypothesis: Abstention and review policy hide different failure modes by split.
hypotheses.primary_signal: Nonprediction, review, and monitor rates differ by hidden family and component owner across validation and test aggregate summaries.
hypotheses.revise_if: Action rates are stable and unrelated to misses.

hypotheses.name: runtime_variance
hypotheses.hypothesis: Model or runtime variance is being mistaken for a generalisation gap.
hypotheses.primary_signal: Same-raw-output and no-call replays produce stable attribution, while live reruns differ mainly in output contract or stochastic noise.
hypotheses.revise_if: Same-output replay still shows the gap.
